headline: Continued review of 11 Cross Street project to November 5, 2026; issued negative determination for 40 Lyndale Avenue addition.
summary: Enforcement cases at 175 Pelham Street, 30 Conti Drive, and 30 Brown Court were continued into 2027. Voted to send a registered-mail letter to the owner at 60 Ames Street, who had denied the violation and said he would not attend meetings. Three emergency certifications were ratified: two tree removals and one dam breach.
decisions: Continued the Abbreviated Notice of Resource Area Delineation for 1–27 Independence Drive to the next meeting, unanimously.
Continued the Notice of Intent for 11 Cross Street to November 5, 2026, unanimously.
Issued a negative WPA determination for 7 Briarcliff Drive with Special Conditions 1 through 8, unanimously.
Issued a negative WPA determination for the home addition at 40 Lyndale Avenue with Special Conditions 1 through 9, unanimously.
Continued the stormwater permit application for 11 Cross Street to November 5, 2026, unanimously.
Continued the Notice of Violation for 175 Pelham Street to July 15, 2027, unanimously.
Continued the Notice of Violation for 30 Conti Drive to August 19, 2027, unanimously.
Voted to send a registered-mail letter to the owner at 60 Ames Street advising them to appear at the next meeting or face a potential enforcement order and fines, unanimously.
Continued the Notice of Violation for 30 Brown Court to August 19, 2027, unanimously.
Directed the owner of 52 Linwood Avenue by registered letter to stop mowing beyond the markers, and continued the matter to June 3, 2027, unanimously.
Ratified the emergency certification to remove a fallen tree at 52 Hidden Road, unanimously.
Ratified the emergency certification to remove a dead tree at 22 Maplewood Street, unanimously.
Ratified the emergency certification allowing a dam at 38 Oak Meadow Lane to be breached, unanimously.

CITY OF METHUEN 
CONSERVATION COMMISSION 
Minutes of a Meeting – October 15, 2026 
 
The City of Methuen Conservation Commission held public hearings and a public 
meeting on October 15, 2026, at the Searles Building, 41 Pleasant Street, Great 
Hall, Third Floor, and via Zoom Web Meeting. 
ROLL CALL: 
Present were Dave Di Zazzo, Chair; Kenneth Sateriale, Secretary; Patrice Friant, 
Commissioner; Rachel Lecher, Commissioner; and Sandra Boulay, Commissioner.  
A quorum was present.  Also present were Chris Parsons, Conservation Officer, 
and Michelle Davidson, Conservation Clerk. 
PUBLIC HEARING 
1. NOTICES OF INTENT 
A.  Abbreviated Notice of Resource Area Delineation – DEP File #219-1326 – 1–
27 Independence Drive – SRH Colonial Village LLC 
The applicant requested that the matter be continued pending completion of peer 
review. 
MOTION: Motion made by Kenneth Sateriale to continue the matter to the 
next meeting.  Seconded by Sandra Boulay.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous. 
B.  Notice of Intent – DEP File #219-1320, MCC File #26-001 – 11 Cross Street – 
CROSSLD QOZB, LLC, Dresser, Williams & Way, Inc. 
The applicant requested a continuance to November 5, 2026, pending completion 
of peer review. 
MOTION: Motion made by Kenneth Sateriale to continue the matter to 
November 5, 2026.  Seconded by Rachel Lecher.  All in favor.  Vote: 
Unanimous.
Page 2 
PUBLIC MEETING 
1. CALL TO ORDER 
The public meeting was called to order at 7:02 PM.  The Chair reviewed the three-
minute public comment rule, noting that comments must relate to Conservation 
Commission matters and that the Chair may allow additional time when 
appropriate. 
2. ACCEPTANCE OF AGENDA / AMENDMENTS 
The agenda was amended to add Item I under Old Business. 
MOTION: Motion made by Kenneth Sateriale to amend the agenda to add 
Item I under Old Business.  Seconded by Sandra Boulay.  All in favor.  Vote: 
Unanimous. 
3.  ACCEPTANCE OF MINUTES – October 1, 2026 
MOTION: Motion made by Kenneth Sateriale to accept the minutes of 
October 1, 2026.  Seconded by Sandra Boulay.  All in favor.  Vote: 
Unanimous. 
4. NEW BUSINESS 
A.  Request for Determination of Applicability (RDA) #26-008 – 7 Briarcliff Drive 
– John McAndrew 
The applicant was present to answer questions.  The Conservation Officer had 
previously viewed the property.  The Commission considered the Request for 
Determination of Applicability. 
MOTION: Motion made to issue a negative WPA determination with Special 
Conditions 1 through 8.  Seconded by Sandra Boulay.  All in favor.  Vote: 
Unanimous. 
B.  Request for Determination of Applicability (RDA) #26-009 – 40 Lyndale 
Avenue – Ricardo Nassif 
The applicant described the proposed home addition and stated that the required 
testing and permits had been completed.  The applicant requested the 
Commission’s determination before beginning construction. 
MOTION: Motion made by Patrice Friant to issue a negative WPA 
determination with Special Conditions 1 through 9.  Seconded by Sandra 
Boulay.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous. 
5. OLD BUSINESS 
A.  Stormwater Permit Application – 11 Cross Street – Dresser, Williams & Way, 
Inc. 
The matter was continued pending completion of peer review.
Page 3 
MOTION: Motion made by Sandra Boulay to continue the matter to 
November 5, 2026.  Seconded by Kenneth Sateriale.  All in favor.  Vote: 
Unanimous. 
B.  Notice of Violation #25-011 – 175 Pelham Street MDR FL Realty LLC, c/o 
Grieco Automotive Group. 
The Conservation Officer provided an update on site conditions and remaining 
concerns. 
MOTION: Motion made by Patrice Friant to continue the matter to July 15, 
2027.  Seconded by Kenneth Sateriale.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous. 
C.  Notice of Violation #26-004 – 30 Conti Drive – Antonio Conceicao 
The Conservation Officer reported that the property was substantially in 
compliance, with vegetation still needed in the area where bark mulch had been 
placed. 
MOTION: Motion made by Patrice Friant to continue the matter to August 
19, 2027.  Seconded by Kenneth Sateriale.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous. 
D.  Notice of Violation #26-005 – 60 Ames Street – Muhammad Tasleem 
The Conservation Officer reported that the property remained out of compliance 
and that the property owner had not returned phone calls.  Furthermore, Mr. 
Tasleem had sent an email to the Commission denying the violation and stating 
that he would not attend any Commission meeting.  The Commission discussed 
sending formal written notices requiring the property owner to appear at the next 
meeting.  The Commission also discussed the possibility of an enforcement order 
and fines of up to $100 per day if the violation remains unresolved.  The 
Conservation Officer stated that he would consult the appropriate Massachusetts 
Department of Environmental Protection enforcement contact regarding the 
applicable procedure. 
MOTION: Motion made by Kenneth Sateriale to send a letter by registered 
mail advising the property owner to appear before the Commission at its next 
meeting or face a potential enforcement order and fines.  Seconded by Rachel 
Lecher.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous. 
E. Notice of Violation #25-004 – 30 Brown Court – Henrique Alves 
The Conservation Officer reported that the property is in compliance and 
recommended monitoring the site for regrowth next summer. 
MOTION: Motion made by Patrice Friant to continue the matter to August 
19, 2027. Seconded by Kenneth Sateriale. All in favor. Vote: Unanimous.
Page 4 
F.  Notice of Violation #23-013 – DEP File #219-873, MCC File #03-029 – 52 
Linwood Avenue – Ana Diaz 
The Conservation Officer reported that dumping into the vegetated area had 
stopped, but mowing beyond the marked boundary remained a concern, and that 
area was not being maintained consistently.  The Commission discussed issuing a 
written notice directing the property owner to cease cutting beyond the markers 
and monitoring the area during the next growing season. 
MOTION: Motion made to send a registered letter directing the property 
owner to cease mowing beyond the markers and to continue the matter June 
3, 2027, for further review.  Seconded by Kenneth Sateriale.  All in favor.  
Vote: Unanimous. 
G.  Emergency Certification – 52 Hidden Road 
The Conservation Officer reported that the property within the Commission’s 
jurisdiction had a large tree fall on a home during a recent storm.  The tree needed 
to be removed.  The Conservation Officer had issued an emergency certification to 
allow removal of the tree. 
MOTION: Motion made by Patrice Friant to ratify the emergency 
certification.  Seconded by Kenneth Sateriale.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous. 
H.  Emergency Certification – 22 Maplewood Street 
The Commission discussed removal of a large dead tree located on neighboring 
private property near a residence.  Written permission has been obtained from the 
property owner for access and removal.  The Conservation Officer had issued an 
emergency certification to allow removal of the tree. 
 
MOTION: Motion made by Patrice Friant to ratify the emergency 
certification.  Seconded by Kenneth Sateriale.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous. 
I.  Emergency Certification – 38 Oak Meadow Lane  
The Commission discussed an emergency certification related to beaver activity 
and a dam.  The Conservation Officer issued an emergency certification to allow 
breaching of the dam. 
 
MOTION: Motion made to ratify the emergency certification.  Seconded by 
Kenneth Sateriale.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous. 
6. CONSERVATION OFFICER’S REPORT 
A. 30 Hidden Road - The Conservation Officer reported that the property owner 
had misunderstood prior guidance regarding invasive Japanese knotweed removal 
and had also cut other vegetation.  The owner indicated that the mistake would not 
be repeated.  No Commission action was taken.
Page 5 
B. The Conservation Clerk provided an update regarding a bond submitted to the 
city in connection with 30 Argilla Road.  Commissioners’ signatures are needed on 
bond documents.  
7. OTHER BUSINESS 
The Chair thanked Patrice Friant for her service to the Conservation Commission, 
noting that this was her final meeting and expressing appreciation for her 
contributions. 
8. ADJOURNMENT 
There being no further business, a motion to adjourn was made by Patrice Friant 
and seconded by Kenneth Sateriale.  All in favor.  Vote: Unanimous.  The meeting 
adjourned at approximately 7:22 PM. 
 
Respectfully submitted by, 
Dave Di Zazzo 
 
Approved by: 
Kenneth Sateriale, Secretary 
 
 
Submitted for the Commission: 
Michelle Davidson, Clerk 
 
 
 
Date: ____________________
